validate.unknown_ticker: {ticker} not in {sources} — EU or OTC broker code? map it to a Yahoo symbol under `aliases:` in watchlist.yaml or prices won't resolve
validate.zero_price_sell: sold at 0 — worthless disposal/delisting? this realizes the full loss of the position
validate.duplicate: identical row already in ledger — re-importing an overlapping export doubles the position
validate.near_duplicate: a {action} of {quantity} {ticker} on {date} is already in the ledger at a different price — the same trade read twice?
validate.oversell: sell of {quantity} exceeds {held} held on {date} — missing earlier buys or a split?
validate.split_added: {ratio}:1 split on {date}, from Yahoo's corporate actions — the statement doesn't carry it, and the sells after it don't add up without it
